verdict.rationale: Stripe documents that one Checkout integration (hosted or embedded) accepts one-time and subscription payments from more than 125 local payment methods. Payment Links also let customers pay with their preferred payment method in their local currency, so the single-integration core of the story is covered. missing for 10: explicit naming of Apple Pay and Google Pay wallets, named bank-redirect and BNPL methods, independent or hands-on corroboration.
